summary: Nutrition sync paginates the foods collection and authentication diagnostics distinguish a configured personal API key from the public DEMO_KEY fallback.
reason: The foods endpoint declared pageNumber and pageSize but was marked non-paginated, truncating sync after its first page; AuthHeader's intentional DEMO_KEY fallback also made status and doctor misreport a personal credential as configured.
validated_outcome: Regression tests assert foods uses page pagination and DEMO_KEY remains usable without being reported as a configured credential.
